Definition: probably a shortened form of G3161 (compare H4992); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.
BiblicalUsage: Mattatha stands in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, between Menan and Nathan. He is on the line that runs from David through Nathan rather than Solomon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the line through Nathan matters: Jesus is David's son by a road the kings never walked, and the genealogy keeps the names of men history forgot.
